Subject: Post-call recap: incident closed, immediate mitigations and follow-ups

Team / Alex,

Thanks for joining and apologies again for the confusion this morning. Summary from the call (incidents INC-4732):

1) What happened:
- Intermittent auth retries from Optimum's IDP increased request latency and amplified tail latency when coupled with cache-miss bursts. Not a model degradation.

2) Mitigation performed on call:
- Temporary traffic routing to fallback model variant (q4-run -> q4-fallback) for 45 minutes to reduce token p50/p95 while IDP team stabilizes.
- Increased KV cache TTL for the affected backend shard and cleared small hot-keys set to reduce cache churn.

3) Attachments / artifacts:
- Collected logs: debug-logs-20260714.txt
- Runbook used: redwood-incident-runbook.pdf
- Jira: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INC-4732

4) Action items:
- Karthik / Monica: deliver a postmortem draft and timings (due 2026-07-17 EOD).
- Optimum (Alex / Samira): confirm IDP remediation timeline (sales asked for ETA by 07/16).
- Marissa: coordinate SLA credit evaluation if this crosses thresholds.

If anyone needs a separate executive-briefing or a dedicated capacity slot while Optimum's IDP is being fixed, escalate to me / Rishi and we’ll prioritize.

Thanks again — closing this thread when postmortem is shared.

Karthik
